results.name: All five resources can be gathered on contact, from hexes you own
results.evidence:
wood: 3->5 (+2) in ONE frame on contact — item 48, hex 2 (4 pips, 19 items, 17 left), hex claimed with 6 roads + a settlement
brick: 4->6 (+2) in ONE frame on contact — item 96, hex 4 (5 pips, 22 items, 20 left), hex already ours
wool: 2->3 (+1) in ONE frame on contact — item 264, hex 12 (5 pips, 22 items, 21 left), hex claimed with 5 roads + a settlement
wheat: 3->4 (+1) in ONE frame on contact — item 72, hex 3 (1 pips, 10 items, 9 left), hex already ours
ore: 2->3 (+1) in ONE frame on contact — item 0, hex 0 (3 pips, 16 items, 15 left), hex claimed with 2 roads + a settlement

results.name: The hex number means two things: how many items it holds and how fast they come back
results.evidence:
5-pip hex 4 (brick): 22 items (declared 22), all 22 swept in 13 contacts -> exhausted=true, back in 14s of 14s = 1.571 items/s sustained
1-pip hex 1 (wool): 10 items (declared 10), all 10 swept in 10 contacts -> exhausted=true, back in 26s of 26s = 0.385 items/s sustained
more items on the better hex: true (22 vs 10) · faster regrowth: true (14s vs 26s) · 4.08x sustained supply
no swing speed involved: every item came off in a single frame of contact
